reviewContext.userProblem: Finish dps-17-wiring: owner-decided test updates, golden fixture, store identity test, page palette/action/navigation tests, PDF text for individual exports, desktop/ExportDialog document export tests, CLI Markdown and native parity tests, docs, examples and final gates.
requiredOutcomes: All dps-17-wiring acceptance criteria met; impl-plans/progress/dps-17-wiring.md records the final verification.
Page tile, page-frame actions, snippet palette entries, inline snippet editing and the document PDF/Markdown export menu are covered by tests.
docs/cli.md, docs/editing.md, docs/import-export.md and README.md describe snippets, page frames and flow, slideshow and document export; examples/document paper and deck exist and load.
bun test packages/ir packages/io packages/core packages/ui-solid apps/cli/src, mise run verify and mise run test-cli pass on the final tree.
nonGoals: Redesigning or re-implementing accepted dps-01..16 or the committed dps-17 wiring.
A new Command kind, dependency, version bump or CSS token.
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths, their progress file and their evidence directory. No git state changes, no any, no emojis.

Owner decisions for bpmn-palette.test.ts, interaction-creation.test.ts, text-runs.test.ts and shape-search.test.ts are final (design 10.2). Pre-authorized tests may only be extended; never delete, skip or loosen assertions.
Rust builds use a per-plan CARGO_TARGET_DIR (target/dps-17f) except mise run verify and mise run test-cli in dps-17-final, which use the default target dir.
Native parity and test-cli: up to 3 attempts only on deadline timeouts; deadlines never relaxed; never run parity without NODETTO_CLI_TEST_BINARY.
JSONL round trips stay byte-identical; TypeScript snippets use canonical language javascript (IR-W1-DPS15-CANONICAL-LANG).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: collectTextRuns gains optional include predicate; rasterExportSnapshot returns textRuns from the SVG viewBox rect filtered by expandContainers for artboard/selection; AssetExportSection passes them to pngToPdf.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Design 10.2; individual PDF exports must carry extractable snippet text without changing documentPdfPlan.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: createExportHandlers gets optional deps.rasterizeSvg; ExportDialog exports EXPORT_FORMAT_GROUPS and documentExportFormats.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Design 10.2; DOM-free behavioural tests with no UI change.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: dps-17f depends on dps-17b only, for the golden fixture document-pages.jsonl.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Real data contract; everything else is disjoint and parallel.

residualRisks: Whole-repo bun run typecheck in a parallel wave can see a sibling mid-edit; rerun after joining before declaring failure.
Canvas PageUp/PageDown editable-target guard (Canvas.tsx:343-365) is covered by citation, not a DOM test.
intentionalTradeoffs: Examples test lives in a new apps/cli/src/document-examples.test.ts (dps-17g) instead of document-wiring.test.ts so docs/examples and CLI parity run in parallel.
dps-17-final edits no source; failures are repaired serially by the owning plan.
supportedEdgeCases: Read-only documents disable addPageFrame; next/previous page-frame actions are enabled only when page frames exist and move the camera without a history entry.
Individual PDF exports (page, artboard, selection) carry snippet text; unselected overlapping snippets contribute no text.
Document Markdown export via explicit --format markdown --document --output <file.md> and the shorthand produce byte-identical output in Bun and native CLI.
Store identity of markdown layout cache holds after updateSemantic and updateVisual.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: DOM-level test of the Canvas PageUp/PageDown editable-target/presentation guard (covered by code citation only).
New export formats, UI redesign of ExportDialog, or changes to documentPdfPlan / pdf-document.ts.

acceptedDependencies.provides: Registration, tools, catalogue, palette tiles, page-frame actions, PageUp/PageDown, snippet editor dispatch, ExportDialog Document group, desktop document handlers, CLI types/help.

acceptanceCriteria: bpmn-palette.test.ts expected action list includes addPageFrame, nextPageFrame, previousPageFrame in Toolbar order.
interaction-creation.test.ts skips palette entries with an action and separately asserts exactly one Page entry with action add-page-frame.
shape-search.test.ts requires a catalogue shape only for non-action entries and asserts the exact action-id list.
No assertion deleted, skipped or loosened; the three files pass.

sharedPathNotes.intendedEdit: Edit only if the store identity test fails on the unchanged file; then key the cache by (semantic.markdown, width, fill).

acceptanceCriteria: document-pages.jsonl (canonical serializer output) holds a vertical page with two A4 frames, a text.markdown, a text.code (rust, line numbers) and a shape.geo, and a horizontal page with one slide-16-9 frame; document PDF has 3 pages.
GOLDEN includes document-pages; golden round trip and coverage pass.
document-snippets-wiring.test.ts covers validation, SVG classes, getText/setText, clipboard/duplicate, extractor keys and store identity after updateSemantic and updateVisual.
Progress log records whether layout.ts changed.

sharedPathNotes.intendedEdit: Extension only, and only if it fails because of the new actions; same rule for app-palette, page-actions, viewer-actions and interaction-keyboard-menus tests.

acceptanceCriteria: document-wiring.test.ts asserts the 3 palette tiles in order, addPageFrame enablement (read-only disabled), one-step undo, next/previous shortcuts PageDown/PageUp, enablement only with page frames, viewer availability, camera navigation without history change, and labels.
Any edit to the listed existing tests only extends exact lists and is recorded in the progress log.

sharedPathNotes.intendedEdit: Add only the optional trailing include?: (element: Element) => boolean parameter to collectTextRuns; default behaviour unchanged.

pdf-document.ts is unchanged.
